title: arXiv Mathematics — 1 October 2026 announcement batch
global_caveat: arXiv provides no official trending chart. This inferred shortlist is based on explicit claimed results and mathematical scope, not readership; new papers have limited usable citation and independent-discussion evidence.

sections.title: Vector balancing in convex order
sections.abstract: Constructs balanced signing laws with hard discrepancy limits and convex-order guarantees, and reports resolutions of several named conjectures across discrepancy, matrix inequalities, probability, and information theory.
sections.claimed_result: The author’s Theorem 1.1 gives, for real matrices with column Euclidean norms at most one, a signing law with outcome-wise discrepancy below 6.8383231851485 and a joint convex-order comparison; the abstract also claims several named conjecture resolutions.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Explicit discrepancy theorem: real matrices with Euclidean column norms at most one; other abstract claims have their own settings and hypotheses.
sections.unique_caveat: Broad single-author preprint with many substantial claims that need expert proof review; its explicit bound is not universal across all discrepancy problems.

sections.title: Strong Artin Conjecture for Generalized Octahedral Representations in GL₃
sections.abstract: Proves automorphy for three-dimensional Artin representations with projective image C₃² ⋊ SL(2,3), and derives the strong Artin conjecture for all six-dimensional primitive solvable Artin representations.
sections.claimed_result: The author proves automorphy for generalized octahedral representations with projective image C₃² ⋊ SL(2,3), using a new automorphic-induction/base-change case for non-Galois quartic extensions, and deduces the stated six-dimensional result.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Irreducible Artin representations in the specified projective-image class; secondary consequence for primitive solvable representations of dimension six.
sections.unique_caveat: Settles the stated solvable case, not all three-dimensional Artin representations; other projective-image cases remain outside this result.

sections.title: Positive-temperature spin-glass order on the three-dimensional Migdal–Kadanoff lattice
sections.abstract: Proves positive-temperature spin-glass order on diamond hierarchical lattices, including the n=4 Migdal–Kadanoff lattice used as a three-dimensional analogue, with explicit computer-assisted Gaussian-coupling cases.
sections.claimed_result: For bounded-density coupling laws and n≥4, the author proves low-temperature ordering uniformly over lattice level; computer-assisted arguments cover stated Gaussian temperatures for n=3,4,5,7,8 and larger n under the paper’s conditions.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Ising spin glass on a diamond hierarchical lattice with independent identically distributed couplings; n=4 is a Migdal–Kadanoff three-dimensional analogue, not the cubic lattice Z³ itself.
sections.unique_caveat: The paper explicitly leaves positive-temperature ordering for the Edwards–Anderson model on Z³ open; the hierarchical result does not settle it.

sections.title: Half-space KPZ equation from a class of nonlinear SPDEs
sections.abstract: Derives the half-space KPZ equation as a continuum limit of a class of Ginzburg–Landau SPDEs under weak-nonlinearity scaling; authors characterize it as first beyond integrable models.
sections.claimed_result: The author derives the half-space KPZ equation from a class of Ginzburg–Landau stochastic PDEs in the weak-nonlinearity limit.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Specified class of Ginzburg–Landau SPDEs and weak-nonlinearity scaling; abstract does not enumerate detailed hypotheses.
sections.unique_caveat: The “first” and universality characterizations are the author’s framing; abstract alone does not expose precise admissible SPDE class or boundary-parameter range.

sections.title: Symmetric-determinant apolarity in odd characteristic
sections.abstract: Determines the apolar ideal of the generic symmetric-matrix determinant over fields of odd characteristic and gives exact thresholds for weak and strong Lefschetz properties.
sections.claimed_result: The author gives generators for the apolar ideal and proves weak Lefschetz exactly when N≤2p−2, and strong Lefschetz exactly when N<p.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Generic symmetric N×N matrix determinant; differential operators act by ordinary differentiation over a field of odd characteristic p.
sections.unique_caveat: Explicitly restricted to odd characteristic; characteristic two is outside the stated result.

sections.title: H-principle for corank two distributions of odd rank and maximal first Kronecker index
sections.abstract: Establishes an h-principle and a topological existence characterization for a constrained class of corank-two distributions of odd rank with maximal first Kronecker index.
sections.claimed_result: The authors prove ampleness of the differential relation and deduce a complete criterion for a (2N+3)-dimensional manifold to admit the specified distribution.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Corank two, odd rank 2N+1, and associated pencil of skew forms in the generic orbit/maximal-first-Kronecker-index class.
sections.unique_caveat: The theorem concerns this restricted class, not arbitrary corank-two distributions; for N≥2 it is a proper subclass of a broader class.
